note: 完整文本草稿，未配音或发布。引用既有表达库及S03/S04草稿表达；不包含猜测的音频时间轴。

series.title: 内核补丁维护：灰度、驱动检查与分批重启
series.premise: 为四台catalog-api虚拟机安装发行版提供的安全内核补丁。预发布已跑过基础测试，生产尚未开始；计划窗口五十五分钟，逐台退出流量并重启。
series.outcome: 确认驱动签名、旧内核与带外控制台回退准备；一台生产灰度通过启动、驱动和业务验证后，逐台完成其余三台维护。按计划结束并留下真实回退演练与自动验收改进任务。

accentTarget.basis: spoken audio duration excluding silence and narration

phraseDefinitions.zh: 内核升级引入的功能退化或故障
独立于常规网络连接的管理控制台
未经可信签名的内核模块
由配置管理统一维护的配置

recycling.note: 每段一个新表达与五个已引入表达。候选后续回访需按相应场景细化，不能把未编稿的排期算为已复现。

dialogues.title: 申请维护：哪四台，什么时候动
dialogues.premise: catalog-api四台虚拟机需要安全内核补丁，先确认窗口和变更范围。
dialogues.listeningTask: 听清维护对象、预计耗时和不属于本次变更的节点。

lines.en: I'd like a maintenance window for the catalog hosts. Four machines, kernel patch only.
lines.zh: 我想申请catalog主机的维护窗口。四台机器，只做内核补丁。

lines.en: Are the enrichment workers included? That memory investigation isn't finished.
lines.zh: 包含订单补充信息消费者吗？那项内存调查还没有结束。

lines.en: No, the root cause is still open there. Those hosts are out of scope.
lines.zh: 不包含，那边根因仍未查明。那些主机不在本次范围内。

lines.en: Just to confirm, no app release alongside this, right? Keep the change isolated.
lines.zh: 我确认一下，不同时发布应用，对吧？保持变更单一。

lines.en: Good. Mixing changes would make any new error harder to explain.
lines.zh: 好。混合变更会让新错误更难定位。

lines.en: Agreed. What's the ETA for approval? I'm proposing fifty-five minutes tonight.
lines.zh: 同意。审批预计什么时候完成？我建议今晚留五十五分钟。

lines.en: Does that include checks and time to back out? Not just reboot time?
lines.zh: 包括检查和回退时间吗？不是只算重启吧？

lines.en: Yes. Like one worker at a time, but these are API hosts. One host only.
lines.zh: 包括。类似一次只处理一个消费者，不过这里是API主机，一次只动一台。

lines.en: Let's review capacity before approving. Three hosts need to carry the live traffic.
lines.zh: 批准前先评审容量，其余三台需要承担线上流量。

lines.en: A full fleet refresh? Let's park that. This request is just the patch.
lines.zh: 整组机器更新的事先放一边。这次申请只涉及补丁。

dialogues.title: 评审补丁：发行版补丁也要验证
dialogues.premise: 已确认只维护四台catalog-api主机，旧内存事件节点被排除。
dialogues.listeningTask: 分辨已有测试证据、尚未覆盖的风险和批准所需材料。

lines.en: What's our evidence against a kernel regression? Which tests ran in staging?
lines.zh: 有哪些证据能降低内核回归风险？预发布跑过哪些测试？

lines.en: Boot, network, and storage checks passed. Same image family, same Secure Boot setting.
lines.zh: 启动、网络和存储检查通过。同一镜像系列，Secure Boot设置也一致。

lines.en: Same driver versions too? A matching image name doesn't guarantee matching modules.
lines.zh: 驱动版本也一致吗？镜像名字一致不代表模块一致。

lines.en: App tests passed under load. Memory headroom stayed healthy throughout the run.
lines.zh: 应用通过了带负载测试，运行期间内存余量一直正常。

lines.en: Just to confirm, no memory pressure in that run, right? Attach the graphs.
lines.zh: 我确认一下，那次测试没有内存压力，对吧？把曲线附上。

lines.en: If anything got OOM-killed, we'd need to separate capacity from kernel behavior.
lines.zh: 如果有进程被OOM机制终止，我们得区分容量问题和内核行为。

lines.en: Nothing did. I checked the kernel log too. We can rule that out for this test.
lines.zh: 没有。我也查了内核日志，可以排除这次测试中发生过OOM。

lines.en: I'll compare the driver manifests next. That's the remaining gap in the evidence.
lines.zh: 接下来我会对比驱动清单，那是当前证据还缺的一块。

lines.en: Maybe add a longer soak later. The current test doesn't cover every production pattern.
lines.zh: 以后可以增加长时间测试，现在的测试覆盖不了所有生产模式。

lines.en: Agreed. Record the limitation. We still need a small first batch tonight.
lines.zh: 同意，把限制记下来。今晚仍然要从小批次开始。

dialogues.title: 逐台发布：容量够不够不能靠感觉
dialogues.premise: 补丁测试通过，驱动清单正在复核，开始确认逐台执行顺序及容量。
dialogues.listeningTask: 听出单台维护的容量前提、故障域分布和并行执行限制。

lines.en: We'll use a staged rollout. Host A first. Then one node at a time.
lines.zh: 我们分阶段发布，先A主机，然后一次只处理一台节点。

lines.en: Can three hosts handle tonight's traffic with room for a spike?
lines.zh: 今晚三台能承担流量，并给突增保留余量吗？

lines.en: The load test says yes. Three hosts covered the recent peak with spare capacity.
lines.zh: 负载测试结果可以。三台能覆盖近期峰值，而且还有余量。

lines.en: Just to confirm, no two hosts draining together, right? Even in different zones?
lines.zh: 我确认一下，不同时让两台退出流量，对吧？不同区域也不行？

lines.en: Right. We should also confirm the remaining hosts span both failure zones.
lines.zh: 对，也要确认剩余主机仍分布在两个故障域。

lines.en: I'm on it for the schedule. What's the ETA per host, including validation?
lines.zh: 执行安排我来负责。每台包括验证预计多久？

lines.en: Allow ten minutes. If one takes longer, stop and reassess the window.
lines.zh: 留十分钟。如果一台超时，就停止并重新评估窗口。

lines.en: I'll keep an eye on latency. We shouldn't use the whole margin on maintenance.
lines.zh: 我会留意延迟，维护不能把全部余量用光。

lines.en: I'll record the before-and-after checks. No next host until the current one passes.
lines.zh: 我会记录操作前后检查。当前这台没通过，就不能动下一台。

lines.en: Okay. Probably forty minutes of work, with fifteen left for delays or rollback.
lines.zh: 好。大约四十分钟操作，剩下十五分钟用于延误或回退。

dialogues.title: 什么情况回退：先把条件说清
dialogues.premise: 确定A主机先做灰度，其余逐台推进，批准前明确回退与停止条件。
dialogues.listeningTask: 区分暂停发布、诊断及真正回退，记住明确触发条件。

lines.en: What's the rollback trigger? Let's agree before anyone starts changing hosts.
lines.zh: 什么情况触发回退？任何人开始改主机前先达成一致。

lines.en: Failure to boot, missing network or storage, or a confirmed regression in the canary.
lines.zh: 无法启动、网络或存储不可用，或者灰度节点出现已确认的回归问题。

lines.en: A latency spike alone means pause first. Check the evidence before blaming the patch.
lines.zh: 仅延迟突增先暂停，查看证据后再判断是不是补丁的问题。

lines.en: Let me play that back. Pause on uncertainty, roll back when the canary fails agreed checks?
lines.zh: 我复述一下：不确定时暂停，灰度节点不满足约定检查时回退？

lines.en: Exactly. Just to confirm, the recovery window includes checks after backing out, right?
lines.zh: 对。我确认一下，恢复窗口也包括回退后的检查，对吧？

lines.en: Yes. The app stays off traffic until health and business checks pass again.
lines.zh: 包括。健康和业务检查再次通过前，应用不接回流量。

lines.en: And rollback may mean another reboot. Keep the old kernel and its modules available.
lines.zh: 回退可能还需要一次重启，所以要保留旧内核及对应模块。

lines.en: I'm on it. I'll verify the boot entry and the console access before draining.
lines.zh: 我来核对。退出流量前先验证启动项和控制台访问。

lines.en: If console access fails, it's a no-go. We can't rely on SSH after a bad boot.
lines.zh: 控制台访问失败就不能开始，启动异常后不能指望SSH仍然可用。

lines.en: A broader rollback redesign? Let's park that. Verify tonight's documented procedure first.
lines.zh: 更全面的回退方案重设计先放一边。先核实今晚文档规定的流程。

dialogues.title: 先退出流量：控制台就绪再重启
dialogues.premise: 维护批准，回退条件明确，开始A主机灰度并准备带外访问。
dialogues.listeningTask: 听清请求排空、旧内核保留和重启开始条件。

lines.en: The out-of-band console works. Old kernel entry is present. Host A is ready to drain.
lines.zh: 带外控制台可用，旧内核启动项存在。A主机可以退出流量了。

lines.en: Does your account have reboot access there? A visible console isn't the whole check.
lines.zh: 你的账号在那里有重启权限吗？能看到控制台不代表检查完整。

lines.en: Yes, permissions are verified. I won't test a reboot outside the approved sequence.
lines.zh: 有，权限已核实。我不会脱离批准顺序去试重启。

lines.en: Just to confirm, active requests must finish first, right? No abrupt service stop.
lines.zh: 我确认一下，先让在途请求结束，对吧？不直接停服务。

lines.en: Traffic is removed. I'm watching active connections and the other hosts' latency.
lines.zh: 已摘除流量。我正在看活跃连接和其他主机的延迟。

lines.en: I'll keep an eye on background jobs too. They don't show up as incoming connections.
lines.zh: 我也会盯着后台任务，它们不会显示为入站连接。

lines.en: Good. Confirm those are idle before stopping the app and rebooting.
lines.zh: 好。确认后台任务空闲后，再停应用并重启。

lines.en: I'm on it. Jobs are idle now. What's the ETA for the final connection check?
lines.zh: 我来确认。后台任务现在空闲了，最后的连接检查预计多久？

lines.en: Done. No active requests. Let's keep it under observation when it comes back.
lines.zh: 完成，没有活跃请求。启动回来后继续观察。

lines.en: Okay, proceed with A only. Call out the boot result before restoring traffic.
lines.zh: 好，只操作A主机。恢复流量前先报告启动结果。

dialogues.title: 机器起来了：驱动签名也要核对
dialogues.premise: A主机已进入新内核，仍未接回流量；开始验证网络、存储与驱动加载。
dialogues.listeningTask: 听懂模块文件存在与成功加载的区别，不把关闭安全机制当快速修复。

lines.en: Host A is back. Running kernel matches the patch. Network and storage are visible.
lines.zh: A主机启动了，运行中的内核符合补丁版本，网络和存储都可见。

lines.en: Loaded drivers too? An unsigned module could be rejected with Secure Boot enabled.
lines.zh: 驱动也加载了吗？开启Secure Boot时，未签名模块可能被拒绝。

lines.en: Just to confirm, we check the loaded module, right? Not just the package files?
lines.zh: 我确认一下，要检查实际加载的模块，对吧？不是只看软件包文件？

lines.en: Exactly. Check the loaded version and kernel messages for signature failures.
lines.zh: 对。检查已加载版本，并看内核日志是否有签名验证失败。

lines.en: I'm on it. Both drivers loaded. Signatures match the trusted vendor packages.
lines.zh: 我在查。两个驱动都加载了，签名来自受信任的供应商包。

lines.en: Okay, we can rule that out here. What's the ETA for the service checks?
lines.zh: 好，这里可以排除签名问题。服务检查预计多久？

lines.en: About two minutes. I'll keep an eye on link errors while they run.
lines.zh: 大约两分钟。检查期间我会留意链路错误。

lines.en: If a driver fails elsewhere, we stop. No turning off Secure Boot as a shortcut.
lines.zh: 其他主机如果驱动失败就停止，不把关闭Secure Boot当作捷径。

lines.en: Agreed. Keep that host off traffic, then follow the approved recovery path.
lines.zh: 同意。让那台保持不接流量，然后走批准的恢复流程。

lines.en: So far, no new errors. I'll attach the versions and log checks to the change.
lines.zh: 目前没有新错误。我会把版本和日志检查附到变更记录。

dialogues.title: 健康检查之外：业务请求真的成功吗
dialogues.premise: A主机网络、存储和驱动验证通过，准备先做业务检查再恢复少量流量。
dialogues.listeningTask: 区分进程健康、业务验证和生产流量观察。

lines.en: Health endpoint is green. I'll run the smoke test through our approved test route.
lines.zh: 健康端点正常。我会通过批准的测试路由跑关键功能快速验证。

lines.en: Does it exercise dependencies? A healthy process can still fail real requests.
lines.zh: 会覆盖依赖吗？进程健康也可能处理不了真实请求。

lines.en: Yes. Catalog lookup, cache access, and database reads. Test credentials only, no production writes.
lines.zh: 会，商品查询、缓存访问和数据库读取。只用测试凭据，不执行生产写操作。

lines.en: Just to confirm, routing reaches A specifically, right? Not one of the healthy hosts?
lines.zh: 我确认一下，路由明确到A主机，对吧？不是误打到其他健康主机？

lines.en: Yes, the response identifies A. Dependency checks pass and error counts stay flat.
lines.zh: 对，响应标识来自A。依赖检查通过，错误数没有增长。

lines.en: Memory headroom looks normal too. What's the ETA before we restore a little traffic?
lines.zh: 内存余量看起来也正常，预计多久可以恢复少量流量？

lines.en: Now, if the checks are recorded. Use the approved low weight first.
lines.zh: 如果检查已记录，现在可以。先用批准的低权重。

lines.en: I'm on it for approval. Let's keep it under observation before increasing that weight.
lines.zh: 我来确认批准。提高权重之前先保持观察。

lines.en: We'll compare latency and errors against the untouched hosts, under the same traffic mix.
lines.zh: 我们会在相同流量组成下，与未变更主机比较延迟和错误。

lines.en: Maybe five minutes for this first check. If traffic is too light, we'll need longer.
lines.zh: 首次观察大约五分钟。如果流量太低，就需要更久。

dialogues.title: 继续还是停：灰度验收后再放行
dialogues.premise: A主机在低权重真实流量下表现正常，证据已记录，决定是否逐台继续。
dialogues.listeningTask: 听清继续发布的依据、负责人和下一台的前置条件。

lines.en: Time for the go/no-go. Anika, are the business checks good enough to proceed?
lines.zh: 该决定继续还是停止了。Anika，业务检查结果足够支持继续吗？

lines.en: Yes. Error rate and latency match the other hosts. We've seen enough requests.
lines.zh: 是的，错误率和延迟与其他主机一致，观察到的请求数量也够了。

lines.en: And no driver errors? We need both app and host checks for that decision.
lines.zh: 也没有驱动错误？这项决策需要应用和主机两方面检查。

lines.en: None. Just to confirm, one node at a time still, right? B next, not B and C.
lines.zh: 没有。我确认一下，仍然一次一台，对吧？接下来B，不是B和C一起。

lines.en: Let me play that back. Restore A's normal weight, verify it, then drain B?
lines.zh: 我复述一下：先恢复A的正常权重并验证，然后让B退出流量？

lines.en: Exactly. What's the ETA for all remaining hosts if each check stays clean?
lines.zh: 对。如果每次检查都正常，其余主机预计多久全部完成？

lines.en: About thirty minutes. Pause if a step runs long; don't shorten validation to catch up.
lines.zh: 大约三十分钟。某一步超时就暂停，不要为了赶进度缩短验证。

lines.en: I'll keep an eye on errors as the weights change. Call out each transition.
lines.zh: 权重变化时我会关注错误。每次切换都要说清楚。

lines.en: I'll keep a separate result for each host. A passing doesn't prove B will pass.
lines.zh: 我会分别记录每台结果。A通过不代表B必然通过。

lines.en: A is fully back now. Checks are clean. I'll start B's drain next.
lines.zh: A已完全恢复流量，检查正常。接下来让B退出流量。

dialogues.title: 四台完成：回退准备别立即删
dialogues.premise: B、C、D已分别退出流量、重启并验收，全部恢复正常权重；核对最终状态。
dialogues.listeningTask: 听清当前验收范围，以及为什么仍要保留旧内核和回退证据。

lines.en: All four hosts run the patched kernel. Each has passed the same checks.
lines.zh: 四台都运行补丁内核，每台都通过了同一套检查。

lines.en: Normal traffic weights too? No host left drained or stuck on the test route?
lines.zh: 流量权重也恢复正常了？没有主机还被摘流量或卡在测试路由上？

lines.en: All normal. Latency and errors look healthy. We're back to baseline across the fleet.
lines.zh: 全部正常。延迟和错误指标健康，整个主机组回到基线了。

lines.en: Just to confirm, we can still boot the old kernel, right? Don't clean it up tonight.
lines.zh: 我确认一下，现在仍然能用旧内核启动，对吧？今晚不要清掉它。

lines.en: Right. Keep the approved previous version and its modules for the observation period.
lines.zh: 对。在观察期间保留批准的前一版本及对应模块。

lines.en: I'll keep an eye on the host logs. We didn't need rollback during this change.
lines.zh: 我会关注主机日志。这次变更没有实际用到回退。

lines.en: So record it as prepared, not exercised. We haven't tested that path in production.
lines.zh: 所以要记为已准备，而不是已演练。我们没有在生产走过这条路径。

lines.en: Just to recap, service checks passed. Let's circle back after the overnight observation.
lines.zh: 小结一下，服务检查通过。夜间观察后我们再确认。

lines.en: If errors appear, preserve evidence first. Then follow the agreed pause and rollback rules.
lines.zh: 如果出现错误，先保留证据，再按约定的暂停和回退规则处理。

lines.en: Agreed. I'll tell support maintenance is complete, with monitoring continuing overnight.
lines.zh: 同意。我会告知支持团队维护已完成，夜间监控仍继续。

dialogues.title: 更新手册：把验收证据写进流程
dialogues.premise: 维护在批准窗口内结束，未触发回退；记录结果并安排流程改进任务。
dialogues.listeningTask: 抓住后续任务的责任、期限和验收标准，不把未执行的回退写成通过。

lines.en: Just to recap, we finished inside the window. Driver and service checks passed on every host.
lines.zh: 小结一下，我们在窗口内完成，每台主机的驱动和服务检查都通过了。

lines.en: Keep the patch settings in managed configuration. No one-off edits left behind.
lines.zh: 补丁相关设置保持在统一配置管理中，不留下临时手工修改。

lines.en: First action item: compare the final state with the approved template. I'll do that tomorrow.
lines.zh: 第一个行动项：把最终状态与批准模板对比。我明天完成。

lines.en: Who's picking this up for the checklist? Add loaded drivers and actual kernel version.
lines.zh: 检查清单谁来改？要加实际加载的驱动和运行中的内核版本。

lines.en: I'll own the business checks by Friday. They need to identify the target host.
lines.zh: 业务检查我负责，周五前完成，必须能确认目标主机身份。

lines.en: Raj, can you own the host checks too? We need one clear owner, right?
lines.zh: Raj，主机检查也由你负责可以吗？要有明确负责人，对吧？

lines.en: And schedule a rollback drill in staging. Tonight's preparation isn't evidence of a successful rollback.
lines.zh: 还要安排预发布回退演练。今晚的准备不能当作回退成功的证据。

lines.en: Yes, by Thursday. I'll attach the drill results so we can close the loop.
lines.zh: 可以，周四前完成。我会附上演练结果，反馈并闭环。

lines.en: I'll verify the evidence afterward. Keep the follow-up tasks open until those checks pass.
lines.zh: 之后我来核验证据。检查通过前，后续任务保持未关闭。

lines.en: Agreed. Let's take it offline for the drill schedule. Thanks, everyone. No more changes tonight.
